branding.label: Branding
branding.hint: Icon, colors and logo of admin screens. Empty fields use the site settings (or the defaults).

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.hint: Icon shown on the browser tab of admin screens while this template is active.

logo.label: Admin logo
logo.hint: Logo used in the admin sidebar. Leave empty to use the site logo.

accent.label: Accent color
accent.hint: Color of buttons, links and notice boxes.

color_scheme.label: Default color mode
color_scheme.hint: Mode shown to first-time visitors. Visitors who already picked a mode (including this browser) keep their choice.
